description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. C. Pallegama as an Additional Secretary and Mrs. J. K. N. Dilhani as an Assistant Secretary to the President's Staff
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (Mr. Chandraratne Pallegama as Additional Secretary and Mrs. J.K.N. Dilhani as Assistant Secretary) with basic titles only. No detailed portfolio responsibilities or ministerial assignments are mentioned, and there are no structural/administrative changes to government organizations. The content fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses exclusively on named individuals with their basic appointment titles.
